sources.quote: | Claude Sonnet 4 ([retired, except on Bedrock and Google Cloud](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations))  | $3 / MTok         | $3.75 / MTok    | $6 / MTok       | $0.30 / MTok             | $15 / MTok    |
sources.supports: Anthropic lists Sonnet 4 cache writes at $3.75 per million and cache hits at $0.30 per million, with input/output at $3/$15.

sources.quote: Pricing remains consistent with previous Opus and Sonnet models: Opus 4 at $15/$75 per million tokens (input/output) and Sonnet 4 at $3/$15.
sources.supports: Anthropic announced Sonnet 4 input/output pricing as $3/$15 at launch.

notes: The earlier models.dev record had the cache read and cache write amounts reversed. Anthropic’s documentation identifies the official Sonnet 4 values as $0.30 per million cache reads and $3.75 per million 5-minute cache writes. The sources do not establish when models.dev corrected its own record or a provider price change date.
